"# Technical Investigation & Design Report: Google TV Cinema Scrub Bar (Milestone UI-M3)

**Author**: Explorer 1 (`explorer_ui_m3_1`)  
**Role**: Player HUD & Cinema Scrub Bar Explorer  
**Date**: 2026-11-05  
**Target Platform**: LG webOS 8.5.0 / LG 32LR686BPSA (1920x1080 10-Foot Television Canvas)  
**Assigned Working Directory**: `/home/prem/webos-projects/cinejoy-webos/.agents/teamwork/explorer_ui_m3_1/`

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Milestone UI-M3 modernizes the CineJoy LG webOS Media Player Heads-Up Display (HUD) overlay and timeline scrub bar to reflect Google TV / cinema-grade design language (`theboringtv-lgwebos` reference design), while preserving 100% of underlying playback pipelines, spatial D-pad navigation, and test contracts.

Explorer 1 was tasked with investigating `app/js/player.js`, `app/css/components.css`, `app/index.html`, and related test suites (`app/test-m5.js`, `tests/adversarial-m5-osd-remote.js`, `tests/adversarial-m5-stress.js`, `tests/run-all-tests.js`) to produce an actionable engineering design for:
1. **Google TV Cinema Scrub Bar**: Slender progress track with elapsed time (`#e8eaed`, Google Sans), buffered range visualization, and remaining time display (`-HH:MM:SS` in `#bdc1c6`).
2. **Visual & Spatial Dimensions**: 8px resting track expanding to 12px on spatial focus, high-contrast 24px thumb with 5px white halo ring + neon lime glow, and smooth cubic-bezier transitions.

   - Buffered Fill: Semi-transparent white (`rgba(232, 234, 237, 0.35)`) smoothly displaying ahead-of-playhead network cache.
